newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude, products end higher, remain volatile.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude, products end higher, remain volatile.

text.p: Crude oil and product futures ended higher Thursday, recovering ground lost the previous day but remaining volatile ahead of a meeting Friday between the Energy Secretary and oil industry representatives.

The two sides are to discuss ways to alleviate the effects of high heating oil prices this winter due to low stocks, illustrated in Thursday's Energy Information Agency (EIA) report showing a drop of 900,000 barrels in inventory last week.
November heating oil futures ended 73 points higher at 72.29 cents a gallon, while crude was up 25 centsat $25.42 a barrel.
